omitted_network: Official third network with individually open load returns; it is not the floating-star network.
source_type: Two independent, identical ideal balanced positive-sequence three-phase sources, each source neutral grounded
grounded_load_returns: Three ideal returns connected to ground; load phase voltages equal source phase-to-ground voltages
floating_load_returns: Three returns joined at floating:n; no earth path or artificial leakage
current_positive_direction: Each source phase node to its corresponding load resistor and then load neutral; i:Vg:* and i:Vf:* are opposite source-branch currents
reference_neutral_reconstruction: v_neutral = v_grounded_1 - v_floating_1; both retained sources have identical waveforms
initialization: Pure resistive algebraic network; no capacitor, inductor or controller states
pycy_method: trapezoidal (no storage; algebraic solution independent of integration method)
reference_local_solver: Backward Euler, sample time=0.0001 s, residual tolerance=1e-9
